summary: CTW, a Tokyo-based Nasdaq-listed game platform operator, furnished a Form 6-K solely to correct a typographical error in the venue address for its annual general meeting previously disclosed in a November 9, 2026 filing. The corrected address is Sumitomo Shiba Koen Building, 17th Floor, 2-7-17 Shiba, Minato-ku, Tokyo (previously misstated as 2-8-17). A revised press release, notice of AGM and form of proxy were furnished; meeting date, time, agenda and all other arrangements are unchanged. This is a routine administrative correction with no special-situations or risk-arb implications.
